acceptance_criteria.text: New and reconciled US-listed securities use stable FIGI-domain keys where applicable, issuer identity is separate from security identity, effective-dated listing/provider-symbol history is retained, and unresolved candidates are quarantined without silent merges.
Canonical bars distinguish instrument, market/feed scope, session, timeframe, adjustment basis/version, and provenance; existing OHLCV reads remain compatible through a default series mapping.
Exchange sessions, timezones, holidays, early closes, overnight trade-date rules, and user-local projections are versioned and used by freshness and daily-completion logic.

Provider routing filters by capability, asset/venue/session/interval/history/feed/terms entitlement, health, quota, and workload budget; quota reservations are safe across workers and every decision is observable.

Whole-universe core-session D1 refresh, tiered intraday polling, local rollups, exact missing-slice repair, request coalescing, deferred broad-evaluator runs, and automatic retry are implemented without provider calls inside evaluation loops.

Provider adapters cover the approved practical roster, with US identity/lifecycle, OHLCV, corporate actions, market events, SEC facts/core fundamentals, earnings, FINRA short interest, crypto, current options, and optional futures paths represented honestly by capability and provenance.

Current option chains and quotes are retained; QuantLib-backed American-option Greeks and the existing fallback are labeled with model/version/input provenance and tested against numerical edge cases.

Backend-only admin and diagnostic APIs expose capabilities, entitlements, quota/cost usage, routing decisions, coverage, identity quarantine, sessions, queue/degradation state, anomalies, and detailed shadow reports.

New routing defaults remain disabled until a separately approved deployed 30-day shadow run produces automated daily/final reports, at least 99% eligible core-session D1 coverage before the next regular session, no silent identity/license/quota violations, and AI-readable discrepancy evidence.
Existing symbol-based API aliases and legacy yfinance-dependent paths remain functional only through explicit compatibility behavior; yfinance is absent from default and acceptance routing.

Focused unit, adapter-fixture, migration, PostgreSQL/Redis integration, worker, API, numerical, point-in-time, and full backend integration validation pass; every live-enabled provider has either bounded keyless evidence or an explicit credential preflight failure; no frontend files are modified.

No provider policy contains a generic 60/min, 15-burst, 2-concurrency, or 30-second fallback. Unknown limits are represented as NULL/unknown, excluded from routing, and surfaced with the exact missing contract dimensions.

429/418/quota responses parse provider reset headers where present, stop the affected provider scope, persist a typed capacity event, defer work until the reset (or operator decision), and do not create a retry storm or unsafe fallback.

The manifest-driven live matrix covers keyless and credentialed providers separately. Missing credentials identify exact environment variables and block ready-for-review; no live skip is represented as proof.

Local worktrees, GitHub live validation, and deployment targets use separate explicit secret stores; no credential is tracked, routine PR CI receives no provider secret, and provider credentials reach only trusted backend/worker processes.
